description: This Java class AssetDataValidator extends DataValidator to perform validation logic for Asset entities, including checks for tenant existence, customer assignment, and entity count constraints.

classes.name: AssetDataValidator
classes.description: A Spring component class that validates Asset entities during creation and update, ensuring data integrity and consistency within tenant and customer relationships.

methods.name: validateCreate
methods.description: Validates creation of an Asset, checking the number of entities per tenant.

methods.name: validateUpdate
methods.description: Validates update of an Asset, ensuring the asset exists before updating.

methods.name: validateDataImpl
methods.description: Performs detailed validation of Asset data, including name, tenant existence, and customer assignment.
